findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "get_my_history" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_my_history" references sensitive artifacts (password, secret, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_endpoints, get_my_history · Private data: get_my_history · Public sink: get_my_history · Destructive: search_endpoints.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_endpoints, get_my_history · Private data: get_my_history · Public sink: get_my_history · Destructive: search_endpoints

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "call_endpoint" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
